statements.t: “Our Q3 results reflect the strength of our differentiation and execution, with strong revenue growth, significant year-over-year gross margin expansion, and adjusted diluted EPS 1 growth of 10.3%, and we are raising our full year 2026 gross margin and adjusted diluted EPS 1 guidance to reflect this,” said Sumita Pandit, Chief Financial Officer, Genpact .
◦ In Advanced Technology Solutions, we expect revenue to grow at least 25% year-over-year.
◦ In Core Business Services, we expect growth to continue year-over-year.
